View complete instructions, controls, and pro tips
Live community recommendations, auto-sync across users, freshness period, and voting.

• Live Multi-User Sync: All community recommendations sync in real time every 20 seconds across all users without restarting the app.
• 7-Day Freshness Window: Recommendations stay active for 7 days from when they are submitted, keeping the catalog fresh and highlighting active community trends.
• Recommendation Counter: Movie poster cards display a red recommendation badge with the current vote count so you can easily spot popular gems.
• Toggle Your Recommendation: On any movie or series detail page, click the 'Pakcik Rekomen' button to cast your recommendation or click again to remove it.
• Android TV Navigation: Use your remote D-pad to focus the Pakcik Rekomen button on movie detail pages and press Center / OK to vote directly from your couch.
Wirelessly cast movies and series to Smart TVs, Chromecast, and Google TV devices.

• Wireless TV Casting: Tap the Google Cast button in the top navigation bar or inside the video player to connect to your Chromecast or Google TV.
• Subtitle Passthrough Server: The app features an embedded local WebVTT subtitle streaming engine that converts and streams subtitles directly to your TV screen.
• Stream Format Auto-Detection: Cast is optimized for direct MP4 and VIP cloud servers. If an external web mirror is incompatible with Cast, switch to an alternative server tab.
• Phone & Tablet Remote: Use your mobile device as a convenient remote control for play, pause, seeking, and volume adjustment while streaming on the big screen.
• Resume on Disconnect: When disconnecting from your TV, playback automatically resumes locally on your phone or tablet right where you stopped.
Full guide for navigation, seeking, server switching, and audio controls using your remote control.

• D-Pad Navigation (Up / Down / Left / Right): Navigate through movie cards, categories, and settings menus smoothly with high-contrast TV focus indicators.
• Center / OK Button: Open the focused video card, start playback, toggle Play / Pause during movie streaming, or expand help guides.
• Seekbar Control (Left / Right): While playing a video, press Left to rewind 10 seconds or Right to fast-forward 10 seconds. Hold Left or Right for continuous rapid scrubbing.
• Back Button: Return to the previous screen or exit playback. When returning to the home screen or search results, your scrolled position and last focused movie card are perfectly preserved.
• TV Sidebar Drawer: On the home screen, navigate to the far left to open the sidebar menu (Home, Search, History, Favorites, Settings, Exit). Pressing Home while on the home screen smoothly scrolls back to the top and refreshes the catalog.
• Up Arrow During Playback: Reveals player controls, server selector, and video quality selector.
• Down Arrow During Playback: Opens the subtitle selection and audio track panel directly without leaving full screen.
• Pakcik Rekomen & Details: All detail screen action buttons, server tabs, and episode cards are fully remote-accessible with dedicated D-pad focus.
• Menu / Info Key: If your remote has a Menu key, pressing it opens video stream properties and available alternative mirror sources.
Intuitive touch gestures for brightness, volume, seeking, aspect ratio, and Picture-in-Picture.

• Tap Screen: Tap anywhere on the playback area to toggle the visibility of controls, title banner, and scrub bar.
• Vertical Swipe (Left Half): Swipe up or down on the left side of the screen to adjust display brightness dynamically.
• Vertical Swipe (Right Half): Swipe up or down on the right side of the screen to increase or decrease media volume smoothly.
• Double-Tap to Seek: Double-tap the left third of the screen to jump backward 10 seconds. Double-tap the right third to fast forward 10 seconds.
• Picture-in-Picture (PiP): Press your device Home button or swipe to home while playing a video to continue watching in a resizable floating mini-window while using other apps.
• Aspect Ratio Scaling: Tap the aspect ratio toggle button at the top right of the player to switch between Fit (original movie aspect ratio) and Fill (zoom to fill entire screen).
• Screen-Off Sleep Protection: Locking your phone screen automatically pauses playback to conserve battery life and cellular data.
How multi-provider streaming works, switching servers, and resolving buffer or dead stream issues.

• Multi-Provider Mirror Aggregation: DreamStream automatically aggregates streaming links across verified partner servers (Duta, Pencuri, LK21, and fast cloud mirrors).
• Automated External Mirrors: If cloud servers are blocked or unavailable, the deep crawler scans verified YouTube, Dailymotion, and Bilibili mirrors with strict title and release year verification.
• Dead Stream Failover: If a video server URL expires, gets blocked, or fails to connect, the engine detects the dead stream within 2 seconds and prompts recovery options.
• Find Other Sources: On the movie detail page or player error screen, click 'Find Other Sources' to run a real-time deep search across alternative provider domains and discover fresh working links.
• Quality Selection: Select between 1080p, 720p, 480p, or 360p depending on your internet connection speed. For slower Wi-Fi or mobile data, 720p or 480p offers uninterrupted playback with zero buffering.
• Hardware GPU Decoding: The player prioritizes hardware-accelerated video decoders on your chipset for maximum power efficiency and 60fps playback without CPU overheating.
Calibrate screen borders, UI scaling factor, and hero banner height for televisions.

• TV Overscan Margins: If UI edges or buttons are cut off by your television screen, go to Settings > Display Adjustment (TV) to adjust horizontal and vertical margins.
• Interface Scaling Factor: Adjust the overall UI scale between Compact (100%) and Large (120%) to match your room size and distance from the television.
• Hero Banner Height: Adjust the height of the top featured movie banner on the home screen to your personal browsing preference.
• Remote-Friendly Sliders: Use your TV remote D-pad to adjust values with the plus and minus buttons, with changes previewed and saved immediately.
Automatic subtitle fetching, language selection, styling, and setting your default subtitle.

• Automatic Subtitle Search: When starting any video, the app automatically queries multi-language subtitle repositories matching the title and release year.
• Closed Caption (CC) Picker: Click the CC button in the player overlay to choose from available subtitle languages (English, Malay, Indonesian, Japanese, Chinese, Thai, Arabic, etc.).
• Set Default Subtitle Language: Navigate to Settings > Subtitles to choose your preferred default subtitle language. The player will automatically activate that language whenever a matching track is found.
• Subtitle Timing & Audio Ducking: Playback pauses or ducks volume smoothly during phone calls and alarms, resuming precisely without desynchronizing subtitles.
Customize your home catalog rows, filter genres, reorder categories, and hide unwanted sections.

• Manage Home Categories: Open Settings > Manage Categories to view and organize Core Catalog, Regional Cinema, Streaming Platforms, Genres, and Release Years.
• Toggle Category Visibility: Turn individual category rows on or off to personalize your home screen and focus on the genres you watch most.
• Quick Action Controls: Use 'Enable All' or 'Disable All' to quickly set multiple categories, or 'Reset Defaults' to return to the original layout.
• Smart Sort Modes: Group category rows by Categorized, Active First, or Alphabetical (A-Z) ordering.
Navigating multi-season series, episode lists, and automatic next-episode queueing.

• Season Tabs: Multi-season TV series and anime display interactive season tabs. Click any season to instantly filter its respective episode list.
• Universal Episode Resolution: All episodes are extracted dynamically from modern series layouts. Each episode card displays episode number, title, and streaming status.
• Auto-Next Episode: When an episode finishes playing, the player automatically cues up the next episode in sequence for binge-watching without needing to return to the catalog.
• Watched Status: Episodes and movies you have viewed are tracked so you can resume where you left off easily.
How to join discussions, customize your nickname, edit or delete comments, and use TV remote navigation.

• Post Comments: Scroll to the bottom of any movie or series detail page to view and post comments.
• Nickname Memory: Enter your preferred display name once; the app remembers your nickname across sessions.
• Edit & Delete Your Comments: Comments you post are tagged with a red 'YOU' badge. Click the pencil icon to edit your text or the trash icon to delete it.
• Confirmation Dialogs: Editing and deletion require confirmation to prevent accidental modifications.
• Android TV Navigation: Use the D-pad remote to navigate smoothly between the nickname field, comment box, and Post button.
Understanding the gold star rating badges shown on poster thumbnails.

• IMDb Rating Badges: Gold star rating badges at the top-right corner of posters indicate the title\'s IMDb score.\n• Real-Time Extraction: Ratings are fetched live from movie databases and streaming catalogs.\n• Clean Catalog Display: If a movie is newly released or unrated, the badge is hidden automatically to preserve a clean poster view.
How the 1-click in-app updater works, permissions, and fallback options.

• Automatic Update Checks: The app checks for new updates automatically at launch and can be checked manually in Settings > About > Check for Updates.
• 1-Click In-App Download: Click 'Update Now' to download the new version directly within the app. A real-time progress bar displays downloaded megabytes, total size, and percentage.
• Automatic Package Installer: Once the download completes, the Android package installer is launched automatically to complete the update.
• Android 8.0+ Unknown Apps Permission: If Android displays a prompt to allow installing unknown apps from this source, click Settings, toggle the permission to Allow for DreamStream, and press Back. The dialog will display an 'Install Now' button ready to proceed without re-downloading.
• Telegram Channel Fallback: A secondary Telegram button is always available in update dialogs to download files manually or consult announcements.
Useful tips for high-speed streaming, TV overscan, voice search, and memory management.

• Cache Optimization: If the app feels heavy after browsing many titles, go to Settings > Storage > Clear Image & Metadata Cache to instantly free RAM without losing your watchlist.
• Android TV Overscan Calibration: If the edges of your screen are cut off on your television, navigate to Settings > Display Adjustment (TV) to scale the interface to your exact screen borders.
• TV Remote Voice Search: When browsing the catalog, click the microphone button on the search bar or use your TV remote microphone to speak the movie or series title directly.
• Direct In-App Updating: New versions can now be downloaded and installed in 1 click directly through the app without manually searching Telegram or using external browsers.
• Unblock ISP Restrictions: The built-in DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) engine automatically secures domain resolution. If your Wi-Fi provider restricts streaming mirrors, the app auto-heals and bypasses blocking automatically.
Solutions for common streaming problems, sluggishness, and connectivity errors.

• Issue: Video is buffering or loading slowly.
 Solution: Click the quality button in the player and switch to 720p or 480p, or switch to an alternative server tab at the bottom of the player.
• Issue: Google Cast connection fails or video does not play on TV.
 Solution: Ensure your phone and TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network. If the server is not compatible with Cast, switch to a Direct MP4 or Cloud server tab in the player.
• Issue: Movie poster images are blurry or not loading.
 Solution: Go to Settings > Storage and click 'Clear Image & Metadata Cache', then restart the app. The app will fetch high-definition 780p/1080p posters.
• Issue: Video player displays a black screen or 'Dead Stream' message.
 Solution: Click 'Find Other Sources' to trigger an automated mirror crawl and recover an alternative active stream.
• Issue: Audio is playing but no picture is visible.
 Solution: Your device hardware decoder may need a reset. Exit the player, wait 2 seconds, and re-open the title. In Settings, verify that your display resolution matches your television.
• Issue: No subtitles found for my language.
 Solution: Some rare or newly released titles may only have English or Indonesian subtitles available initially. Fresh subtitles are populated as subtitle communities release them.
